root_idea.summary: The root develops around two related orientations: bringing something into existence and becoming separate, clear, or free from something else.
root_idea.development: The creation branch yields بَرَأَ and بَارِئٌ, while the separation branch yields recovery from illness, exemption from claims or obligations, disavowal, mutual separation, cleansing, and investigation undertaken to remove doubt.

senses.definition: To bring into existence; to create or produce.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, the verb takes the thing brought into existence as its object. The lexical evidence allows application to created beings and, more broadly, to created things or events.

senses.definition: To absolve, acquit, or declare someone free of blame, accusation, or implication.
senses.usage_conditions: A transitive construction in which the person cleared is the object; the matter from which someone is cleared may be expressed with مِنْ.

senses.definition: To cure, heal, or restore someone from illness.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic use concerns restoring a person afflicted by disease to health or recovery; the construction is transitive.

senses.definition: To dissociate oneself from, disown, renounce, or declare oneself clear of someone or something.
senses.usage_conditions: A subject-oriented reflexive construction, commonly followed by مِنْ; it expresses repudiation or non-involvement with a person, act, belief, or other matter.

senses.definition: The Creator, Originator, or Former who brings created things into being and distinguishes them in their forms.
senses.usage_conditions: In Quranic usage this active participle is used as a divine epithet.

senses.definition: A state of being clear of, disassociated from, or uninvolved with something.
senses.usage_conditions: The Quranic construction expresses disavowal or separation from an object of worship or other matter, commonly with مِنْ.

senses.definition: A formal declaration of release, disavowal, or immunity, especially an announcement terminating obligations and giving notice or warning.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for a public or formal declaration of freedom from an agreement, obligation, or association.

senses.definition: Exemption or immunity from a debt, claim, obligation, or demand.
senses.usage_conditions: The noun can denote the resulting state of being released from an obligation, not only the announcement that establishes it.

senses.definition: Free or innocent of a fault, wrongdoing, accusation, or blame.
senses.usage_conditions: The adjective may predicate innocence or absence of responsibility; the matter of which someone is free may be expressed with مِنْ or by the surrounding context.

senses.definition: Disassociated from, clear of, or not implicated in a person, object, practice, or cause.
senses.usage_conditions: This relational use expresses repudiation or lack of connection and commonly occurs with مِنْ.

senses.definition: Clear or quit of a debt, claim, duty, or other obligation; exempt from its demand.
senses.usage_conditions: The use concerns liability or an outstanding claim rather than moral innocence or general disassociation.

senses.definition: Created beings; creatures or creation, especially mankind when the context specifies it.
senses.usage_conditions: A collective noun for beings that have been created; the lexical evidence also permits the more specific sense ‘mankind.’

senses.definition: Declared free of blame or accusation; acquitted or cleared.
senses.usage_conditions: A passive participle denoting the result of being absolved or shown innocent, especially with respect to an allegation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To recover or become convalescent from illness; of a wound, to heal or enter a healing state.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form I usage concerning recovery from disease, including partial convalescence while weakness or some illness remains.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become free, clear, or quit of a fault, debt, claim, affair, or liability.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive Form I construction, commonly followed by مِنْ; it can denote immunity from a demand or responsibility.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To keep away from or shun unclean or blameworthy things.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form I avoidance construction, generally followed by مِنْ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To mutually release or separate from one another; to settle with a partner or associate for reciprocal separation.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form III expresses reciprocal clearance or separation between the parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To divorce a wife in return for compensation or relinquishment of part of her due.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A conventional mutual-separation construction in which the spouses become clear of one another through an agreed compensation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To acquit or declare another person free of a fault, debt, claim, or responsibility.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form IV construction; the matter from which the person is cleared may be expressed with مِنْ. This is the broader Classical Form IV use, distinct from the Quranic Form IV healing use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To enter the period or day called البَرَاء.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A rare temporal usage referring to the named lunar-period designation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assert oneself free or clear of a fault or matter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader Classical Form V use of the reflexive verb; the Quranic disavowal use is represented separately under the Quranic form.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To separate from one another, each party becoming clear of the other.
To take exceptional care to remove all remaining urine from the penis and cleanse it completely.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical purification usage concerning the male organ and the remains of urine.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To abstain from sexual intercourse with a purchased or captive woman until menstruation and purification establish that she is not pregnant.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A legal and social usage concerning the waiting period before intercourse in order to establish absence of pregnancy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To investigate or search a thing or matter thoroughly until doubt is removed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or extended Form X usage involving repeated, careful inquiry to obtain certain knowledge.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A hunter’s lurking-place or concealed hunting shelter.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A concrete nominal usage; its plural is بُرَأٌ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A traditional name for a boundary day or night of the lunar month.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Classical authorities differ over whether it denotes the first night, first day, last night, or last day of the month; the term is associated with the moon’s separation from the sun or month.
A Classical adjectival specialization distinct from the Quranic uses of innocence, disassociation, and exemption.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A written instrument conferring immunity or exemption.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal legal or administrative usage derived from release from a debt, claim, or defect.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Recovering or convalescent from illness, especially becoming sound at the close of disease while still weak.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Classical active-participial use distinct from the Quranic divine epithet ‘Creator.’

lane_unit_coverage.note: Form I recovery and becoming free or quit are represented as separate Classical branches.
Avoidance of unclean or blameworthy things is represented.
The Quran-attested declaration, excuse, and warning are covered under بَرَاءَةٌ.
Creation or bringing into existence is represented under Form I.
Pointer and grammatical discussion; no independent lexical meaning.
Clearing or verifying freedom from a matter is represented in the Form II verb and its passive participle.
Mutual separation and compensated divorce are both represented.
Restoring a sick person to recovery is the Quranic Form IV sense.
The clearance branch is represented under the Quranic Form II occurrence identified at 33:69 and retained as a Classical Form IV use.
The rare temporal Form IV usage is represented.
Form V assertion of freedom and Quranic disavowal are covered by the public Quranic sense and its broader branch.
Reciprocal separation is represented under Form VI.
Technical cleansing usage is represented.
Waiting to establish absence of pregnancy is represented.
Thorough investigation to remove doubt is represented.
The hunter’s covert is represented.
Pointer-only cross-reference to بَرِيءٌ.
The lunar-period designation is represented, including the reported variation in its calendrical placement.
Pointer-only cross-reference to بَرِيءٌ.
Innocence, disassociation, exemption, and soundness are all covered.
Exemption is represented under the Quranic noun and the written-release specialization is kept Classical.
Pointer-only cross-reference to بَرِيءٌ.
Created beings or creatures are represented.
The Classical convalescent use of بَارِئٌ is represented separately from the divine epithet.
Pointer-only cross-reference to بَرِيءٌ.
The divine Creator epithet is represented.

cautions: The public Form I headword is normalized to بَرَأَ from the inflected QAC occurrence نَّبْرَأَ.

A Lane citation placed in the Form IV discussion refers to Qur'an 33:69, whose supplied QAC occurrence is morphologically Form II فَبَرَّأَهُ. The clearance meaning is therefore covered under the Quranic Form II while retained separately as a broader Classical Form IV use; no additional Form IV Quran occurrence is inferred.
